top_signals.title: Senegal’s Ambitious Plan to Slash Electricity Costs and Boost Energy Security
top_signals.summary: The government of Senegal has ambitious energy diversification aims, with plans to develop both the country’s oil and gas sector and grow its renewable energy capacity. As part of its Vision 2050 plan, the government aims to reduce energy costs and enhance energy security by diversifying energy sources. The government has announced several renewable projects in recent years and has recently made blocks available for oil and gas exploration to achieve these aims.
